title: Handover landing
description: landing.json in a frozen handover (handovers/<id>/), written by Core.handoverPlan at freeze only when a requirement the handover carries has an approved, unchanged landing note (landings/<requirement>.yaml, judged by Landing.approvalState), listed and hashed in handover.yaml (named there as `landing:`). It is derived, not a copy of the note: no approver and no time (approved.by and approved.at stay out), only the note's own content, whether a person corrected it, and the effect counts stored at approval. Sorted by requirement. The nodes are code-map nodes: they say where inside the elements' code areas the change goes and never widen them. Each landing's requirement and hash join the handover id. designc owns this contract; consumers conform to it. docs/handover-landing.example.json is the shared fixture.

hash.description: The note's content hash at approval (Landing.contentHash), as in the landing_approved ledger row.

corrected.description: True when the person changed what the agent proposed before approving.

path.description: The path in order, UI to store.

principle.description: The design principle the change follows: a property (d.style, d.api, d.ui) on an element, a decision id, or none with why. null when the note names none.

effects.description: The counts stored in the note's approved.effects; null when the note has none.
